title: tabernaemontana pachysiphon var. cumminsii
intro: Tabernaemontana pachysiphon var. cumminsii, commonly known as the Cummins' tabernaemontana, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate pain and inflammation, and combat bacterial infections. The therapeutic actions of Cummins' tabernaemontana include its sedative and antispasmodic effects, which may aid in relaxation and the relief of muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
